subject: Request: short bridge while PO clears - Medicore

From: Alice Dunn <alice.dunn@medicore.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial window for Medicore - procurement delay

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. We're ready to move to a short pilot, but finance is insisting on a PO and our vendor onboarding is taking longer than expected. Legal already signed the SOW, but procurement has flagged an audit step and says the PO will clear next Wednesday (May 26).

This puts our engineers at risk of losing momentum next Tuesday when the trial credits expire. Can Redwood provide a short bridge — even a small token top-up or an extra 7 days — so we can keep the pilot live?

I've attached a screenshot from our procurement portal showing the pending approval.

Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Alice Dunn
Head of Product
Medicore Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick context and the screenshot.

We definitely want to avoid losing momentum here. Two quick asks so I can escalate internally and get an approved bridge: 1) can you confirm the PO expected approval date (procurement already indicated May 26?) and 2) can you share the minimal pilot scope (approx # of sessions/embeddings per day) so I can propose a token amount that covers obvious testing without open-ended exposure.

Camila — looping you in to help size the top-up (and Lauren for a manager-approved exception if needed).

Proposed interim approach: Redwood issues a 7-day trial top-up credit (capped) tied to the Medicore account, with a note that it will be rescinded if the PO is not issued by the confirmed date. If procurement needs a formal memo from us we can provide a one-paragraph addendum.

Alice — quick reply with the expected date and the pilot metrics will help move this fast.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Please include a one-line confirmation for Bob at Medicore that this is a temporary, reconciled credit.

Camila — please confirm you can size & apply the credit. Rishi — I'll follow up if procurement needs a formal approval record.

Thanks,
